summary: Connect sensing, action and changing connections through one task that improves with practice.
outcomes: Explain a sensorimotor feedback loop and where adaptation can occur.
Distinguish short-term adaptation, synaptic plasticity and behavioral learning.
sequence: Reach for an object under changed visual feedback
Trace sensory transduction and motor output
Identify limits of a simplified learning account

visual.question: What changes when repeated movements become more accurate?
visual.interaction: Alter a toy sensorimotor mapping and compare immediate feedback correction with slower adaptation.

practice.task: Interpret three learning curves and propose measurements that distinguish mechanisms.
practice.success: Separates behavioral change from unobserved synaptic explanations.
